ns2:section.sectionText: The first part of the course will cover some classic theoretical papers in banking and financial intermediation. The remainder of the course will examine research on three interrelated topics in financial intermediation: liquidity, financial infrastructure and payments. Students will analyze and critique recent articles and working papers, and develop their own extensions of related research.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS:Economics -UIUC, PHD:Finance -UIUC, PHD: Agr & Applied Econ - UIUC, PHD:Economics -UIUC, or PHD: Finance - UIUC.
